collector.name: staging-collect-runtime-db-transition
collector.databaseReadOnly: remove PGSERVICE and PGSERVICEFILE, force PGOPTIONS=-c default_transaction_read_only=on, and require the query transaction_read_only guard to return one row
collector.testAdapterArguments: forbidden unless MCM_RUNTIME_TRANSITION_TEST_ADAPTERS=1 and trimmed case-folded NODE_ENV is not production
collector.emptyCloudWatchDatapoints: reject; the first real staging collection must establish that quiet queues still publish both required metrics
collector.passRoleEvaluation: an exact Allow resource counts only when no explicit Deny statement can cover iam:PassRole for that role ARN

iamInlinePolicyCanonicalization.source: AWS CLI get-role-policy JSON PolicyDocument object after AWS CLI decoding

durableExecution.singleActiveExecutionEnforcement: exclusive state-directory lock plus one durable active-transition record; stale-lock reclaimers serialize through a versioned recovery lease carrying a host fingerprint and re-read the lock before atomically quarantining a dead same-host PID lock, while live, foreign-host, and fresh unreadable locks fail closed
durableExecution.lockHostPrivacy: lock records contain an unsalted SHA-256 host fingerprint and never the raw hostname; this is a pseudonym, not protection against a hostname dictionary attack, and historical sealed v2 lock evidence remains unchanged
durableExecution.lockOwnership: the releasing process removes a lock only when its random lockId still matches
durableExecution.eventDurability: write and fsync an immutable event containing the complete next-state image before atomically replacing active-transition; load replays a valid contiguous event journal when active state lags

recoveryDecision.preCasStillCurrent: external call did not take effect; retry with the same request token
recoveryDecision.plannedEffectCurrent: external call took effect; record complete without repeating it
recoveryDecision.convergencePending: a phase-specific predicate recognizes an asynchronous intermediate state; retain pending and poll without repeating the external call until planned effect or deadline
recoveryDecision.neither: external interference; record intervention_required and stop

durableExecution.readCurrentProjection: each external adapter must return exactly the phaseStableProjection fields; volatile rollout metadata must be classified by the phase-specific convergence predicate

projectionArrayRules.schedules_switched.rules: one object per (eventBusName,name,targetId), with exact schedule fields from runtime-db-transition-schedule.mjs; reject duplicate identities and sort by ordinal canonical JSON before comparison
projectionArrayRules.legacy_passrole_removed.policies: one object per (roleName,policyName), with exact roleName,policyName,canonicalSha256,legacyPassRoleAllowed,candidatePassRoleAllowed keys; reject duplicate identities and sort by ordinal canonical JSON before comparison

durableExecution.scheduleTargetRequirement: each switched rule must have exactly the approved targetId on the approved event bus and an ECS target with a numeric taskDefinitionArn; bind the exact execution role, schedule expression, task count, launch type, platform version, execute-command flag, tag propagation, normalized awsvpc network digest, and canonical direct JSON Input digest in snapshot, plan, pre-CAS, and planned effect; rule-level role, target retry policy, and dead-letter config are unsupported and represented as null; EnableECSManagedTags must be false if returned, and PlacementConstraints, PlacementStrategy, and CapacityProviderStrategy must be empty if returned; only taskDefinitionArn may change; zero targets, extra targets, or non-ECS targets fail closed
durableExecution.scheduleDigestCanonicalization: SHA-256 of UTF-8 stable JSON with ordinal object keys and preserved array order; awsvpc Subnets and SecurityGroups are sets sorted ordinal before hashing; direct target Input must be a JSON object without duplicate keys or numeric values, never stored in snapshot or plan; InputPath and InputTransformer are unsupported and fail closed
durableExecution.scheduleInputPolicy: Schedule Input must not contain secrets: approved Input SHA-256 values are fixed from the two Terraform jsonencode declarations; secrets belong in task-definition Secrets Manager references. The unsalted digest is a consistency check, not confidentiality for low-entropy input. Network digest is bound to the captured plan but cannot be statically fixed before live subnet/security-group identities are independently observed.
durableExecution.scheduleEffectRequirement: buildScheduleSwitchEffect requires the read pre-CAS projection to equal every approved plan schedule row and constructs an effect by replacing only taskDefinitionArn with a numeric Next family revision; assertScheduleSwitchEffect rejects every other field change. This pure helper does not authorize or perform PutTargets.
durableExecution.projectionAdapterRequirement: AWS adapters must map DescribeServices.taskDefinition and the PRIMARY deployment, DescribeSecret.VersionIdsToStages, DescribeRule plus ListTargetsByRule, and normalized GetRolePolicy to these logical fields; validate exact keys and array identity/order before passing values to the state core
durableExecution.stateMetadataBoundary: the offline plan omits secret ARNs and all secret values; the durable execution state and immutable events may contain approved secret ARNs in phase pre-CAS, planned effect, and observations, but must never contain secret values; protect state and evidence access accordingly
durableExecution.phaseDeadlineEnforcement: the initially persisted deadline is never reset; forward execution checks it before invoke and recovery reads, while rollback may perform a read-only exact-state observation after expiry but must not invoke a forward effect or wait for convergence; unresolved states require intervention
durableExecution.planFreshness: snapshot and plan age are checked only when the transition is initialized; later phase entry relies on the stored plan binding, fresh phase pre-CAS, and the persisted phase deadline

requestTokens.secrets_ready: derive stable ClientRequestToken values from transitionId and component
requestTokens.worker_registered: no AWS token; scan recent family revisions and match the candidate hash before registering
requestTokens.next_registered_disabled: no AWS token; scan recent family revisions and match the candidate hash before registering

durableExecution.iamChangeOwner: terraform variable transition followed by reviewed terraform apply
durableExecution.rollbackProgress: the first beginRollback freezes the reverse order of complete and pending forward phases; a pending phase is read before rollback and is either recovered as applied, closed as a no-op when pre-CAS remains current, or stopped for intervention; retries reuse the frozen targets and never recalculate or reset completed rollback work
durableExecution.rollbackFailureState: intervention_required is durable and cannot be restarted or overwritten by beginRollback; forward phase status and result remain historical facts while repeated rollback failures append to failureHistory under the rollback record and immutable events
durableExecution.manualInterventionRecovery: after an authenticated operator preserves an incident snapshot and nonzero evidence SHA-256, recoverInterventionForRollback rejects control characters in operatorId, accepts only an exact pre-CAS or planned-effect observation, writes an immutable manual recovery event, preserves prior failure details, and resumes the original frozen rollback targets; pre-CAS observation is preCasCurrent and may mean externallyRestored, not never applied; any other observation remains blocked
durableExecution.recoveryLeaseProcedure: stop all transition executors, preserve and hash the state directory, verify the recovery-lease PID is dead and no executor can start, quarantine that exact lease file into incident evidence, then load and reconcile the immutable journal; never edit active state or events by hand
durableExecution.transitionIdReuse: a transitionId is single-use across active state, immutable events, and history using case-insensitive comparison on every platform; reuse is rejected before archiving or mutating the current terminal transition
durableExecution.stateVersionCompatibility: load accepts v2 through v5 state images and rejects unknown versions before repairing a lagging active file; the next durable event upgrades a supported old image to v5; event journal format remains v2

readOnlyAwsAdapterSlice.transport: dependency-injected read-only AWS operation allowlist; no real AWS credential, CLI transport, or mutation is supplied by this slice
readOnlyAwsAdapterSlice.projection: exact phase keys and contracted schedule/policy array identities; active non-deleted secret metadata and version stages only, exactly one approved ECS schedule target, and one ACTIVE Next service with no DescribeServices failures and exactly one PRIMARY deployment
readOnlyAwsAdapterSlice.manualRecovery: an injected operator authorizer must return true and an existing nonempty evidence file of at most 64 MiB must hash to the supplied SHA-256 before the state core recovery call
readOnlyAwsAdapterSlice.remaining: schedule immutable fields participate in snapshot, plan, read projection, and a pure task-definition-only effect check, but schedule writes remain disabled until the live ListTargetsByRule key set is checked; six other phase-specific AWS projections, real authenticated identity provider, AWS read/write transport, mutation CAS, rollback effects, and multi-host behavior require later implementation and validation

candidateImagePolicy: Next and worker may change only the primary container image to their own staging ECR repository pinned by sha256 digest; registration must verify the digest exists and was built from the reviewed main commit.
